title: Ansatz with leftovers (8q)
description: Hero demo: run the debug agent to find and remove redundant gates, then see the verified fidelity gain.

title: GHZ state (100q)
description: Structured, low-entanglement circuit: exact on the MPS backend with bond dimension 2 (dense would need 2x10^31 bytes).

title: Variational ansatz (32q)
description: Hardware-efficient ansatz with linear entanglement: exact MPS run where dense simulation needs 64 GiB.

title: Grover search (3q)
description: One Grover iteration marking |101>; uses Toffoli gates (decomposed into CX + T).

title: QFT round trip (6q)
description: QFT followed by its inverse: long-range gates exercise MPS routing; the agent spots the redundancy.

title: GHZ state (12q)
description: Classic entangled benchmark; exact dense simulation.

title: Broken circuit (validation)
description: Contains an out-of-range qubit, a misspelt gate and a missing parameter.
